title: TypeScript Masterclass: Type Systems & Scalable Architecture
subtitle: Master static typing, generics, union/intersection types, keyof, conditional types, and enterprise architecture.

mods.title: Module 1: Static Types, Interfaces & Type Aliases
mods.desc: Strict types, interfaces, optional fields, and type annotations.

mods.title: Module 2: Generics, Unions & Type Narrowing
mods.desc: Generic functions/classes, discriminated unions, and type guards.

mods.title: Module 3: Utility Types (Partial, Pick) & Mapped Types
mods.desc: Partial, Readonly, Record, Pick, Omit, and conditional types.

title: C# Masterclass: Modern .NET 8 & Enterprise Architecture
subtitle: Master C# 12, .NET 8, LINQ, Entity Framework Core, asynchronous Tasks, records, and dependency injection.

mods.title: Module 1: C# 12 Core Syntax & Control Flow
mods.desc: Types, methods, top-level statements, and namespaces in C#.

mods.title: Module 2: LINQ Queries, Collections & Records
mods.desc: LINQ query syntax, IEnumerable, lambda filters, and records.

mods.title: Module 3: Asynchronous Tasks (async/await) & .NET 8 API
mods.desc: Tasks, async/await pipelines, and cloud microservice patterns.

title: Go (Golang) Masterclass: High-Throughput Cloud Microservices
subtitle: Master Go 1.22, Goroutines, Channels, CSP concurrency, HTTP microservices, and high-performance backend architecture.

mods.title: Module 1: Go Syntax, Packages, Structs & Pointers
mods.desc: Packages, structs, receiver methods, and explicit error handling.

mods.title: Module 2: Goroutines, Channels & CSP Concurrency
mods.desc: Lightweight Goroutines, buffered channels, select, and sync.
mods.starter:
package main
import "fmt"
func main() {
    ch := make(chan string, 1)
    ch <- "Go Concurrent Pipeline Active"
    fmt.Println(<-ch)
}

mods.title: Module 3: Implicit Interfaces & HTTP REST Microservices
mods.desc: Interfaces, net/http microservices, and JSON encoding.

title: Rust Programming: Memory Safety Without Garbage Collection
subtitle: Master ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, pattern matching, traits, concurrency, and WebAssembly.

mods.title: Module 1: Rust Syntax, Mutability & Types
mods.desc: Variables, mutability, functions, and control flow in Rust.

mods.title: Module 2: Ownership, Borrowing & Lifetimes
mods.desc: Single-ownership model, references (&), and borrow checker rules.

mods.title: Module 3: Enums, Pattern Matching, Traits & Error Handling
mods.desc: Option, Result, match expressions, traits, and zero-cost abstractions.

title: Modern PHP 8 & Web Application Architecture
subtitle: Master PHP 8.3, OOP, PDO database security, MVC architecture, REST APIs, and modern PHP ecosystem.

mods.title: Module 1: PHP 8 Basics, Superglobals & Arrays
mods.desc: Variables, superglobals, associative arrays, and loops.

mods.title: Module 2: PHP 8 OOP & Constructor Promotion
mods.desc: Constructor promotion, typed properties, and match expressions.
mods.starter:
<?php
class User {
    public function __construct(public string $name) {}
}
$u = new User("Elena");
echo "User: " . $u->name;

mods.title: Module 3: PDO Database Security & JSON REST APIs
mods.desc: PDO prepared statements, transactions, and REST endpoints.
